text: Indian chess player Gukesh became world champion. Gukesh Dommaraju defeated the reigning champion to become the youngest undisputed world chess champion.
Indian boy dominated chess tournament. Teen grandmaster Gukesh Dommaraju swept through the championship match.
RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.5% for third straight meeting citing inflation concerns.
ISRO successfully launches Chandrayaan follow-up mission to study lunar south pole.
Monsoon session of Parliament to begin next week with focus on new data protection bill.
